name: Stormbringer: Aether Mastery applies its interrupted mana regeneration and crit chance natively (#3674)
contract: Aether Mastery rank 1 (807462) has two effects: effect0 aura 134 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MANA_REGEN_INTERRUPT, EffectBasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = 30; effect1 aura 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, EffectBasePoints 1 + DieSides 1 = +2, unconditional. Rank 2 (807887) carries the same two auras with EffectBasePoints 59 + DieSides 1 = 60 and EffectBasePoints 3 + DieSides 1 = +4. AuraEffect::HandleAuraModRegenInterrupt -> Player::UpdateManaRegen (StatSystem.cpp:1091-1093) clamps GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_MANA_REGEN_INTERRUPT) at 100 and writes power_regen_mp5 + CalculatePct(power_regen, modManaRegenInterrupt) into UNIT_FIELD_POWER_REGEN_INTERRUPTED_FLAT_MODIFIER, exactly the 'X% of your mana regeneration continues while casting' mechanic named in the tooltip - the same aura type and precedent as Chronomancer's Luck (chronomancer-luck-mana-regen-interrupt.json, #2963). COVERAGE LIMIT (identical to that precedent): the harness exposes power only as net state, which also moves with absorbs, procs and other effects, so a power-delta observation would not discriminate; this scenario proves the DATA half only - that each rank's regen-interrupt aura applies and resolves to the DBC's own 30/60 value via aura_amount. A decisive assertion needs a power_regen_interrupted metric added to CoAGameplayTest.cpp (not added here; not requested by #3674). The aura 290 crit-chance half of each rank IS decisively provable: AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4892-4909) calls Player::UpdateAllSpellCritChances synchronously on apply, which spell_crit_chance reads back directly. No module code exists for either rank; both close as a regression scenario only.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Aether Mastery aura before the passive is learned
BASELINE: spell crit chance before either rank
Rank 1's regen-interrupt effect resolves to 30 (data only, see contract)
Rank 2's regen-interrupt effect resolves to 60 (data only, see contract)
DISCRIMINATING: both ranks now add 6 crit chance total (2 + 4)
